description: This file defines data models and a store class for managing the state of various messaging and communication channels, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, and generic message channels. It includes detailed Codable structures for channel statuses and snapshots, and a singleton Observable class 'ChannelsStore' responsible for managing channel metadata, labels, and UI hints.

classes.name: ChannelsStore
classes.description: A singleton Observable class that maintains the current snapshot of channel statuses, configurations, and UI state, providing methods for resolving channel metadata and labels.

methods.name: channelMetaEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the UI meta entry for a given channel ID from the current snapshot.

methods.name: resolveChannelLabel
methods.description: Resolves a human-readable label for a given channel ID, prioritizing meta data, then labels, and defaulting to the ID itself.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailLabel
methods.description: Resolves a detailed label for a channel ID, with fallback to general label if specific detail label is unavailable.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Determines the system image/icon associated with a channel, defaulting to 'message' if none specified.

methods.name: orderedChannelIds
methods.description: Returns the list of channel IDs ordered either by meta data order or by the stored channel order.
